fun_facts: Gunner Stockton’s youth football teams went 65-0, and he didn’t lose a game until seventh grade.
From ages 10 to 14, he played baseball for the East Cobb Astros as a cleanup hitter, catcher and starting pitcher.
At Rabun County High, he was named a MaxPreps All-American in baseball as a freshman and sophomore.
Across four high school seasons, he totaled 13,652 passing yards and 177 passing touchdowns, plus 4,372 rushing yards and 77 rushing touchdowns.
In Georgia’s 2025 SEC Championship win, he threw three touchdown passes and was named the game’s MVP.
